expression_set.plain_language: When Red Team review finds objections, we measure later objection resolution with descriptive cohorts so we can produce Objection Risk Reduction Insight.
expression_set.operator: For red_team_review, compare reviewer_objection_resolution_rate across response windows using method.descriptive_cohort.v1 and emit only descriptive_pattern unless stronger gates pass.
expression_set.executive: GoldenQuill's advantage is that proposal risk review becomes measurable learning, not just reviewer notes lost after submission.
expression_set.contract: OptimizationChainDefinition(optchain.objection-risk-reduction, red_team_review, reviewer_objection_resolution_rate, method.descriptive_cohort.v1, Objection Risk Reduction Insight, descriptive_pattern).
expression_set.causal_careful: This chain shows whether objection resolution improved after Red Team review in the observed cohort; it does not prove Red Team review caused improvement.
expression_set.dashboard_label: Objection Risk Reduction Insight: objection resolution after Red Team review, descriptive pattern.
expression_set.ontology: red_team_review -> measured_by -> reviewer_objection_resolution_rate_window -> evaluated_with -> method.descriptive_cohort.v1 -> proposes -> Objection Risk Reduction Insight.

interpretation_limits: Fixture-level descriptive evidence is not causal proof.
Reviewer objection resolution must preserve funder, program, and org-scope privacy.
Approved reuse requires owner decision before future grant context can act on the chain.
